sources.creator: Thimras

sources.cautions: Original has actual river step and frogs/birds; avoid invented archival flood cause, loud waterfall, repeating fauna. Keep original two existing water details.

studies.zone: Forest Crypt — unfinished occupied winter estate
studies.room: sheltered timber and unfinished pale stone
studies.description: Not a deserted haunted crypt: quiet winter estate construction and the Lifebinder caretaker's inhabited private rooms; short quiet physical wood/furniture gesture once, never a coffin or haunted architectural groan.
studies.negative: no ghosts, coffins, permanent crow calls, inhabited crowd, modern machinery

studies.room: damp masonry with shallow intermittent wet presence
studies.description: Active effort to save books/records amid water, physically enclosed; one distant paper touch that should not sound like ripping or shredding; existing subtle water director details preserved. Do not invent flood cause.
studies.negative: no permanent waterfall, frenzy of pages, ghosts or unspecified past flood cause

studies.zone: Colossus Mine — extraction, architecture workshop and guarded refuge
studies.room: carved rock tunnel ventilation and distant craft bench
studies.description: Actual silver/copper extraction + Garun architectural gallery/workshop, with guards and wolf kennels as implied rooms but NO wolf barking; occasional subtle human repair material, no industrial work beat.
studies.negative: no pneumatic drilling, permanent strikes, factory loop, ghost shouts or wolves

studies.zone: Abyss Bastion — unfinished dragon air-force logistics
studies.description: Open-air flight prep leaks into large unfinished stone hall and supplies/aerie logistics. Distinct from mines; no dragons roaring or already-deployed air force.
studies.negative: no dragon roars, wings, rituals, factory motors, heroic score timbres

studies.zone: Citadel of Ashes — functioning formal administration/command
studies.room: inward formal masonry room and sparse administrative work
studies.description: Command/administration, organized material, restrained stone architecture; less bass-dominant than original without global volume change, occasional distant paper/equipment only.
studies.negative: no ominous machinery rhythm, permanent wrenches, voice/crowd, lava roar

hardConstraints.license: verified original CC0/public domain only; SHA1+SHA256+bytes pinned from actual files before render
